events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Turns 61
events.blurb: On December 3, 1965, The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul', marking a significant shift in their musical direction.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Anniversary
angles.copy: Sixty-one years ago today, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul', an album that changed everything. Still sounds fresh, doesn't it?

events.title: John Lennon: 46 Years Since His Passing
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of music icon John Lennon in New York City on December 8, 1980.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon today, 46 years on. His music and message of peace continue to resonate around the world. A true legend, never forgotten.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
